title: Loc8 Opportunity Draft
description: Durable file-layer draft for one Loc8 / Cable Finder opportunity. Mirrors the sandbox Submit Opportunity form (~61 fields, inventoried 2026-09-19 at loc8.dev.cablefinder.net/opportunity) so chat, MCP, and UI automation fill the same fields. The JSON file is the source of truth; MCP / UI / chat are front doors into it. Sandbox only until Brian approves production use.
$comment: North star: durable deal workspace as files. Property names use plain-language keys; the $comment on each section names the exact DOM control it fills at submit time. Never invent dollar amounts: desiredPricePoint is null unless the customer stated a number.

schemaVersion.$comment: Bump on any breaking change to required fields or enums.

phone.$comment: DOM: partnerPhone. UI pattern expects 303-333-3333 style.

customer.description: Customer Information step (13 controls). Used for serviceability and contract generation; customer is not contacted directly by Pax8.

contactPhone.$comment: DOM: custContactPhone. UI pattern is digits-style (no dashes required).

locationCount.$comment: DOM: numberOfLocationServices. UI QUIRK: the form has a location COUNT field but no repeating address editor. Put site 2..N addresses as free text in notes.opportunityNotes.

address.description: Primary service address. One structured address only — the form has no second address block.

line2.$comment: DOM: serviceAddress2. Unit/suite; omit or empty when none.

line2NotNeeded.$comment: DOM: serviceAddress2NotNeeded. UI QUIRK: when line2 is blank you must check 'I confirm that there is no Unit or Suite number for this location.' instead of filling line2.

zip.$comment: DOM: serviceAddressZip. US ZIP entered as five digits.

country.$comment: DOM: serviceAddressCountry. Not marked required in the DOM; United States used in tests.

selected.$comment: Maps to networkNeeded / sdWanNeeded / phoneVoiceNeeded / tvNeeded. UI QUIRK: individual checkboxes are not marked required in the DOM, but the flow needs at least one service to unlock the sub-steps.

term.description: Contract term. At least one must be true for the flow to advance.
term.$comment: UI QUIRK: checkboxes named mtmTerm, 1yTerm, 2yTerm, 3yTerm. Represented here as mtm/y1/y2/y3 booleans and mapped at fill time.

desiredPricePoint.$comment: HONESTY RULE: never invent a dollar amount. DOM: desiredPricePoint (number input, min 0, default 0). Store null when the customer has not stated a price — the filler leaves the UI default. A numeric string (e.g. "250") fills the input only when the customer actually stated it.

roeDisclaimerConfirmed.$comment: DOM: servicesDisclaimerConfirmation. REQUIRED checkbox: registering an opportunity does not supersede vendor rules of engagement — the account may already be registered/locked by another channel and may be deemed non-commissionable. Must be true to submit.

networkConnectivity.description: Network Connectivity sub-step (22 controls). Required when 'network' is in services.selected.

bandwidthMbps.$comment: DOM: bandwidthSpeed. Entered Mbps-style numeric value, e.g. 1000.

preferredVendors.$comment: Maps to the internetVendor* checkboxes. UI QUIRK: the UI spells 'Medicom' (one m) in this list.

voice.description: Voice sub-step / UCaaS path (11 controls). Required when 'voice' is in services.selected.

voiceType.$comment: DOM: voiceType. UCaaS path verified in sandbox; Zoom available as preferred vendor.

seats.$comment: DOM: numSeats ('Number of Seats/Licenses/Lines'). 100 accepted in the sandbox UCaaS/Zoom test.

preferredVendors.$comment: Maps to the voiceVendor* checkboxes. DOM QUIRK: the Other checkbox is named VoiceVendorOther (capital V).

opportunityNotes.$comment: DOM: confirmationNotes (textarea). UI QUIRK: no review page appears between Notes and final submission — Notes is the last screen before SUBMIT. Put site 2..N addresses here for multi-location, plus a SANDBOX marker on test drafts.

metadata.description: File-layer bookkeeping. Not submitted to the form.

source.$comment: Which front door created or last owns this draft. The file stays the source of truth.

status.$comment: draft = being assembled; dry-run = filled in sandbox UI but not submitted; submitted-sandbox = SUBMIT pressed on loc8.dev.cablefinder.net.

environment.$comment: Sandbox only until Brian approves production use. Production was never exercised.

submittedAt.$comment: Set when status becomes submitted-sandbox. UI QUIRK: the sandbox confirmation shows a success toast with NO opportunity ID, so there is no cfOpportunityId field — record what the confirmation showed in notes instead.
